source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.2

data.summary:
When this model is **destroyed** for the first time:

1. remove it and do not resolve **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** for it
2. at the end of that phase, roll a D6; on a 2+, it returns with D6 wounds left, placed as near as it can be to the spot where it was destroyed, outside **Engagement Range** of every enemy unit
